verdict.rationale: Discord's developer docs explicitly document buttons, modals, slash/application commands, and message components as first-party interaction features for building rich in-chat UI (discord-docs-7,8,9,19,48). This directly matches the story's core ask. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer corroboration of building a full interactive app, and no detail on select menus or full structured layout components beyond buttons/modals.
